Job Summary: The Office Administrator and Accounting Specialist is responsible for general office duties including supporting the financial operations of the organization by performing a range of accounting duties related to accounts receivable, accounts payable, and general ledger functions.

This role ensures accurate financial records, timely processing of transactions, and adherence to internal controls and compliance standards. Core Duties Depending on business needs, responsibilities may include: Accounts Payable Functions: Process vendor invoices, ensuring accuracy, proper approvals, and timely payments.

Match purchase orders and receipts to invoices and investigate discrepancies. Prepare and process payments via check, ACH, or wire transfer. Maintain vendor records and respond to vendor inquiries. Assist with month-end closing and accruals related to AP.

Accounts Receivable Functions: Generate and distribute customer invoices in a timely and accurate manner. Apply customer payments to the appropriate accounts and follow up on outstanding receivables. Monitor aging reports and perform collection activities as needed. Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies or customer concerns.

Assist with revenue recognition and related reporting. General Duties: Reconcile account balances and support general ledger entries. Maintain accurate and organized financial documentation. Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., procurement, sales, operations) to resolve accounting issues.

Support internal and external audits by providing necessary documentation. Contribute to process improvements and efficiency initiatives. Office Administration Support Other duties as assigned. Job Requirements Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience of 3 years).

At least 2 years of experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, or general accounting. Familiarity with accounting software (e.g., Workday, SAP, Oracle, QuickBooks, NetSuite). Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and internal controls. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other MS Office applications.

Excellent attention to detail, organizational, and time management skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Preferred Qualifications: Experience working in a shared services or high-volume transaction environment. Exposure to ERP systems (especially NetSuite). Knowledge of GAAP. At the heart of one of the world's leading reinsurance companies, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role supporting a senior leader who shapes Swiss Re's global underwriting strategy. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment and take pride in bringing order, precision, and calm to complexity - we want to hear from you.

As Executive Assistant to the Group Chief Underwriting Officer (GCUO), you will be a trusted partner and the operational backbone of one of Swiss Re's most senior executives.

This is far more than a traditional EA role - you will be a strategic enabler, ensuring the GCUO can focus on what matters most by seamlessly managing the flow of information, people, and priorities around them.

Your discretion, agility, and proactive mindset will be essential as you navigate a dynamic, international environment at the highest levels of the organisation.

* Diary & Schedule Management: Proactively manage a complex, fast-moving calendar, anticipating conflicts and ensuring the GCUO's time is optimally allocated across priorities
* Strategic Prioritisation: Apply sound judgement to strategically prioritise requests and competing demands, ensuring the GCUO's focus and energy are directed where they matter most
* Gatekeeper Role: Act as a trusted gatekeeper for inbound requests, managing access to the GCUO with professionalism, tact, and efficiency
* People Leadership: Lead, develop, coach, and empower 1 or 2 direct reports, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous growth within the executive office
* Correspondence Management: Handle, prioritise, draft, and coordinate high-volume incoming and outgoing communications in both English and German, ensuring clarity, professionalism, and timely follow-up
* Deadline Tracking: Maintain a rigorous overview of key deadlines and deliverables, proactively flagging and escalating where needed to keep commitments on track
* Meeting Preparation: Compile, organise, and ensure the timely availability of briefing materials, presentations, and background documents for meetings and engagements
* Financial Administration: Manage expense reporting and process incoming invoices accurately and efficiently in line with company policies
* Stakeholder Coordination: Serve as the central coordination point between the GCUO, senior leadership, key internal and external stakeholders - building trusted relationships across all levels
* Confidentiality & Judgement: Handle highly sensitive and confidential information with the utmost discretion, sound judgement, and professionalism at all times
* Operational Excellence: Continuously identify opportunities to improve processes and ways of working to enhance the effectiveness of the executive office
### ###

This role sits within Group Underwriting, a high-impact function at the core of Swiss Re's business. The Group Underwriting team is responsible for setting and steering Swiss Re's global underwriting strategy, standards, and frameworks across all lines of business.

Working at the intersection of risk, strategy, and leadership, the team operates with a global remit and collaborates closely with senior leaders and business units across the organisation. As EA to the GCUO, you will be embedded at the very centre of this influential team, supporting its most senior leader.
### ###

You are a seasoned, highly organised professional who brings calm authority and sharp judgment to everything you do. You are someone who anticipates needs before they arise, communicates with confidence and tact across all levels of seniority, and takes genuine pride in enabling others to perform at their best. You understand the weight of working in a confidential, high-visibility environment and you handle it with grace and integrity.

Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast.

The two co-founders carry the work that decides this company: product, clients, the investor network, the brand. Their time is the scarcest resource in the business, and protecting it will be your mandate.

You manage both calendars across time zones, own both inboxes, plan and oversee travel, prepare the founders for the meetings that matter, and ensure every commitment they make is kept. This is a position of ownership, not a list of tasks.

You exercise judgment, act independently, and involve the founders only when a decision genuinely requires them. You work AI-first, like the rest of the company: tooling carries the mechanical work, and your time goes to judgment, anticipation, and trust.

You report directly to both co-founders and hold one of the most trusted positions in the company.
What you will own
Both calendars across time zones: scheduling, conflicts resolved before they surface, preparation time protected, and our Monday and Thursday meeting rhythm maintained.
Both inboxes: triaged daily, replies drafted in each founder's voice, nothing important left waiting.
Travel end to end: planned, booked, briefed, and resolved in real time when plans change.
Meeting preparation and follow-through: the right briefing beforehand, actions captured and pursued afterward.
The commitment layer: what the founders have promised, to whom, by when, tracked to completion.
The systems behind it all, built on the best AI tooling, so mechanical work never requires attention twice.
You are a fit if you
Have supported a founder or C-level executive at a fast-moving company, and can describe what never required their attention because of you.
Have managed calendars across three or more time zones and understand the craft: buffers, batching, protected working time, and declining requests on someone else's behalf with grace.
Write well enough to draft in another person's voice, and judge well enough to know what can be sent without asking.
Have owned travel end to end, including disruptions resolved before the principal ever felt them.
Can support two principals at once: competing priorities held, both agendas moving, neither founder resolving minor conflicts.
Treat discretion as a reflex: names, transactions, and conversations remain confidential, always.
Build systems rather than task lists: standing rhythms, documented processes, and automation that outlasts your busiest week.
Operate with modern tooling: AI runs your scheduling, briefings, and follow-ups, so your time goes to judgment rather than administration.

Fully remote. This position operates in real time across the founders' working day rather than asynchronously. Meetings across the company batch on Mondays and Thursdays, and you are the one who maintains that rhythm. The best AI tooling, paid (Claude Code, Cursor, top models). Direct trust from both co-founders, full visibility into the company, and a position that grows as the company does.

* Du pflegst und entwickelst den Intranet- und SharePoint-Bereich der International Markets weiter und agierst als IT-Power-User: Du unterstützt die CIO und das internationale Team bei Beschaffungen und bist erste Ansprechperson bei technischen Fragen und Problemen
* Du bringst dich aktiv in Sonderprojekte ein: Du unterstützt bei PowerPoint-Präsentationen, bündelst und konsolidierst Informationen aus unterschiedlichen Quellen und übernimmst bei Bedarf eine tragende Rolle in Projekten - mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum

Als Office Manager (w/m/d) bist du das Herzstück unseres Berliner Offices. Du sorgst dafür, dass im Hintergrund alles funktioniert und sich Kolleg, Kund und Gäste rundum wohlfühlen.

Du hältst unser Office am Laufen. Du koordinierst Hausverwaltung, Vermieter, Handwerker und Dienstleister und kümmerst dich um alles, was einen reibungslosen Office-Alltag ausmacht – von Meetingräumen, Bestellungen und Post bis zu Dokumentationen, Reisebuchungen, Rechnungen und Belegen. Auch ausgewählte Themen für unser Münchener Office liegen bei dir.

Dazu gehören auch unsere internen Events, All Hands sowie die kleinen Dinge, die unsere Office Culture ausmachen – von Geburtstagen bis Merchandise.
Du sorgst für einen großartigen Employee Lifecycle. Gemeinsam mit IT und den relevanten Teams organisierst du ein reibungsloses On- und Offboarding und kümmerst dich um organisatorische Themen rund um Wellbeing und Arbeitssicherheit.
Du übernimmst Projekte und packst an. Ob Event, Umbau oder Umzug: Du koordinierst Timelines, Budgets und Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass es läuft. Und wenn eine Glühbirne gewechselt oder ein Griff festgeschraubt werden muss, machst du das auch einfach selbst.

Background

Du hast Erfahrung im Office Management, Workplace Management, Hospitality, Eventmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.
Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch und fühlst dich mit digitalen Tools wohl.

Du machst unser Berliner Office zu dem Ort, an dem unser Team gerne arbeitet – und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Aufgaben aus People Operations .
Deine Mission
Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für alles, was unser Office ausmacht: Du sorgst dafür, dass der Laden läuft, Gäste sich willkommen fühlen und niemand im Team überlegen muss, wo der Kaffee, das Paket oder der Meetingraum-Adapter geblieben ist.
Heute wird Office Management nebenbei aus dem People-&-Culture-Team mitgemacht. Dein Job ist es, das zu übernehmen, in klare Prozesse zu bringen – und dabei nach und nach in People-Operations-Themen hineinzuwachsen.
Ehrlich gesagt: Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt im Office Management, etwa 70 % deiner Zeit. Die verbleibenden rund 30 % sind People Ops – mit der Perspektive, diesen Anteil auszubauen, wenn Rolle, Team und Unternehmen mitwachsen.
Deine Aufgaben
Office & Facility (Hauptfokus)
Du hältst unser Office in Berlin-Kreuzberg am Laufen: Empfang von Gästen, Post, Lieferungen, Ordnung in Küche, Meetingräumen und gemeinsamen Flächen
Du steuerst unsere Dienstleister – Vermieter, Reinigung, Handwerker, Getränke- und Snacklieferanten – und bist deren feste Ansprechperson
Du verwaltest Zugänge, Schlüssel und Arbeitsplätze und sorgst dafür, dass neue Kolleg:innen ab Tag eins einen fertigen Platz vorfinden
Beschaffung & Budget
Du übernimmst das Bestellwesen für Office, Verbrauchsmaterial und Team-Bedarf
Du prüfst Rechnungen vor, bereitest sie für unser Finance-Team auf und behältst das Office-Budget im Blick
Events & Team-Erlebnis
Du organisierst Team-Events, Offsites, Sommerfest und Weihnachtsfeier – von der Location über das Catering bis zur Logistik
Du unterstützt bei der Organisation unserer Onsite Weeks, wenn unsere remote arbeitenden Kolleg:innen nach Berlin kommen
People Operations (dein Wachstumsbereich)
Du bereitest Onboardings vor: Welcome-Paket, Arbeitsplatz, Stammdaten in Personio, Koordination des ersten Tages
Du pflegst Personalakten und Stammdaten, erstellst Bescheinigungen und steuerst den Rücklauf von Dokumenten
Du behältst Zeiterfassung und Abwesenheiten in Personio im Blick und bereitest Zulieferungen für die Gehaltsabrechnung vor
Du unterstützt im Recruiting: Interview-Koordination in Ashby, Betreuung von Kandidat:innen vor Ort
Du wirkst an People-Projekten mit – von Benefits über unser Mitarbeiterhandbuch bis zu Feedbackzyklen
So arbeiten wir
Ownership von Tag eins: Das Office ist deins. Du entscheidest, wie du es organisierst – mit dem Rückhalt unseres People-&-Culture-Teams.
Struktur statt Feuerwehr: Uns ist lieber, du löst ein Problem einmal richtig und dokumentierst es, als es zehnmal zu lösen. Einfache, verlässliche Abläufe zu bauen, ist Teil des Jobs.
AI als tägliches Werkzeug: Wir nutzen KI-Tools wie Claude unternehmensweit. Ob Textentwurf, Checkliste oder Auswertung – wir erwarten, dass du KI aktiv einsetzt, um schneller und besser zu arbeiten.
Wachstum, das zur Rolle passt: Wie schnell der People-Ops-Anteil wächst, hängt davon ab, wie stabil das Office läuft und welche Themen im Team entstehen. Wir sprechen das regelmäßig und offen miteinander durch.
Dein Profil

s.h: Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du mitbringst
s.t:
Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Unser Team ist international, unser Alltag zweisprachig.
